jobs.title: Agentic AI Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Developer based in India.

We are seeking an innovative AI engineer to design and develop autonomous, multi-agent systems and intelligent workflow automation solutions. You will build systems where Large Language Models can reason, plan, use external tools, and execute complex multi-step tasks with limited human intervention. The role covers agent orchestration, API and enterprise-system integration, memory management, evaluation, and safety engineering. You will work with modern agentic AI frameworks and emerging approaches to build reliable and scalable AI applications. This is an opportunity to contribute to advanced generative AI initiatives in a technically ambitious engineering environment. Your work will directly influence how AI systems can automate sophisticated processes and interact with real-world systems.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, and optimize autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, reflection, decision-making, and multi-step task execution.
Build multi-agent architectures and state-based workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or comparable custom orchestration platforms.
Develop reliable agent loops that enable LLMs to select tools, execute actions, evaluate results, and adapt their approach when required.
Integrate enterprise databases, internal applications, and external APIs with AI agents while implementing appropriate authentication, security boundaries, schema validation, and error handling.
Design short-term and long-term memory mechanisms that allow agents to maintain relevant context throughout extended workflows and interactions.
Develop automated evaluation frameworks to assess agent performance, reliability, task completion, reasoning quality, and failure scenarios.
Monitor and optimize token consumption, latency, execution costs, and overall system performance.
Implement safety mechanisms and guardrails to reduce hallucinations, constrain unintended actions, and prevent unsafe or uncontrolled agent behavior.
Collaborate with engineering and AI teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions.

Requirements

3–7 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI development, machine learning, or a closely related field, including hands-on experience with generative AI or agentic systems.
Advanced proficiency in Python, including asynchronous programming and the development of scalable AI services.
Strong practical knowledge of major LLM provider APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, or equivalent platforms.
Hands-on experience developing agentic applications using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
Good understanding of multi-agent architectures, tool calling, workflow orchestration, prompt design, context management, and LLM-based application development.
Working knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Weaviate, as well as relational databases and data-access patterns.
Experience with Docker and containerized application development.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including modular architecture, clean code, unit testing, version control, and production-quality development practices.
Experience establishing rigorous testing and evaluation methodologies for AI systems, including handling edge cases and failure modes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving AI engineering environment.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

Benefits

Annual compensation of approximately INR 2,500,000–4,000,000 CTC, depending on experience and skills.
Full-time, mid-to-senior-level opportunity.
Remote-friendly working model with flexibility across India.
Location options including Bangalore, Pune, hybrid, or remote across India.
Opportunity to work on advanced agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM applications, and intelligent automation.
Exposure to modern AI frameworks, LLM platforms, vector databases, APIs, and cloud-ready engineering practices.
Opportunity to contribute to production-grade AI systems designed to automate complex workflows and real-world business processes.

Turing is a globally recognized leader in artificial intelligence and software development, dedicated to advancing the capabilities of AI systems and transforming the future of technology. About The Role

We are seeking experienced software engineers at the tech lead level to join our innovative team working on large language model (LLM) evaluation and training datasets. This role involves hands-on software engineering tasks such as automating development environments, triaging issues, and assessing test coverage and quality in open-source repositories. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of high-quality public GitHub repositories and be capable of contributing to the development of datasets that enable LLMs to solve realistic software engineering problems. The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Ruby. They should have a solid understanding of version control systems like Git, containerization tools such as Docker, and experience setting up and managing software pipelines. Familiarity with navigating complex codebases, running, modifying, and testing real-world projects locally is essential. Candidates with a background in contributing to or evaluating open-source projects will have an added advantage. Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment are also required.

Responsibilities

Analyze and triage issues across trending open-source repositories on GitHub to identify challenging tasks for LLMs.
Set up and configure software repositories, including Dockerization and environment setup, to facilitate testing and evaluation.
Assess unit test coverage and quality, providing insights to improve dataset robustness.
Modify and run codebases locally to evaluate LLM performance in bug-fixing and other software engineering scenarios.
Collaborate with research teams to identify repositories and issues that can serve as valuable datasets for LLM training.
Lead and mentor junior engineers, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve project goals efficiently.

Benefits

Joining Turing offers the opportunity to work remotely in a flexible and fully autonomous environment. You will be involved in pioneering AI projects with leading LLM companies, gaining exposure to the latest developments in AI and software engineering. The role provides a platform to enhance your technical skills, collaborate with top-tier professionals, and contribute to impactful research initiatives. Additionally, Turing fosters a culture of continuous learning and innovation, ensuring your professional growth and development are prioritized.

Equal Opportunity

Turing is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences drive innovation and excellence, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join our team.
